To,
All Regional Provident Fund Commissioners
In Charge of Regional/Sub-Regional Offices

Subject : Instructions on handling legal cases where Union of India
is a Proforma party.

Sir,

It has been experienced that the Union of India is invariably impleaded as
Proforma party in cases at different legal forum, When replies are filed on the
behalf of Union of India the same are not brought to the notice of Head Office
with all case details. As a result it unnecessarily causes embarrassment at
eleventh hour. :

2. The Ministry of Labour & Employment vide its letter No. S-35018/6/2014-
SS.II dated 31.03.2014 directed that wherever Union of India is a Proforma
Party, the following actions shall invariably be taken.

(i) Efforts should be made to drop the name of Union of India in cases
where it is only a Proforma Party.

(ii) The draft reply shall be prepared and sent to Ministry through Head
Office for vetting, if any, to be filed on behalf of Union of India
before Hon’‘ble Court.

(iii) Necessary action be taken to defend the interest of Union of India in
these cases under intimation to Head Office and Ministry.

(iv) The development of these cases may be brought to the notice of
Head Office and Ministry from time to time.

3. The above instructions must be followed unfailingly.

Yours faithfully,
